*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: out/analyze_crashes.py
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+OUT = Path("out")
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+data = duckdb.query(
+    """
+    SELECT
+      EXTRACT(year FROM crash_date)::INTEGER AS year,
+      SUM(number_of_motorist_killed)::INTEGER AS motorist_deaths,
+      SUM(number_of_cyclist_killed)::INTEGER AS cyclist_deaths
+    FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """
+).df()
+
+expected_years = list(range(2013, 2026))
+if data["year"].tolist() != expected_years:
+    raise ValueError("The requested year range is not complete in the source data")
+data["difference_motorist_minus_cyclist"] = (
+    data["motorist_deaths"] - data["cyclist_deaths"]
+)
+
+# Option 1: compare the two annual count series directly.
+option1 = data[["year", "motorist_deaths", "cyclist_deaths"]]
+option1.to_csv(OUT / "values_1.csv", index=False)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.8))
+ax.plot(option1["year"], option1["motorist_deaths"], marker="o", linewidth=2.2,
+        color="#2166ac", label="Motorist deaths")
+ax.plot(option1["year"], option1["cyclist_deaths"], marker="o", linewidth=2.2,
+        color="#b2182b", label="Cyclist deaths")
+ax.set(title="Motorist and cyclist deaths in NYC crashes, 2013–2025",
+       xlabel="Crash year", ylabel="Deaths recorded")
+ax.set_xticks(expected_years)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+ax.legend(frameon=False)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_1.png", dpi=160)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Option 2: show the year-by-year size of the difference, rather than both levels.
+option2 = data[["year", "difference_motorist_minus_cyclist"]].rename(
+    columns={"difference_motorist_minus_cyclist": "motorist_minus_cyclist_deaths"}
+)
+option2.to_csv(OUT / "values_2.csv", index=False)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.8))
+bars = ax.bar(option2["year"], option2["motorist_minus_cyclist_deaths"],
+              color="#4c78a8", width=0.72)
+ax.axhline(0, color="#333333", linewidth=0.8)
+ax.bar_label(bars, padding=3, fontsize=8)
+ax.set(title="Annual motorist–cyclist death difference in NYC, 2013–2025",
+       xlabel="Crash year", ylabel="More motorist than cyclist deaths")
+ax.set_xticks(expected_years)
+ax.set_ylim(0, max(option2["motorist_minus_cyclist_deaths"]) * 1.16)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_2.png", dpi=160)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+all_motorist_higher = bool((data["motorist_deaths"] > data["cyclist_deaths"]).all())
+min_gap = option2.loc[option2["motorist_minus_cyclist_deaths"].idxmin()]
+max_gap = option2.loc[option2["motorist_minus_cyclist_deaths"].idxmax()]
+options = {
+    "options": [
+        {
+            "id": 1,
+            "metric": "Annual deaths recorded for motorists and cyclists",
+            "denominator": "None; raw annual death counts",
+            "grouping": "Year and road-user group",
+            "chart_type": "Two-series line chart",
+            "reason": "It directly compares the annual levels and trends for both road-user groups.",
+            "probability": 0.75,
+            "answer": (
+                "Recorded motorist deaths exceeded cyclist deaths in every year from 2013 to 2025; "
+                f"in 2025 the counts were {int(data.iloc[-1]['motorist_deaths'])} and "
+                f"{int(data.iloc[-1]['cyclist_deaths'])}, respectively."
+            ),
+            "interpretation": (
+                "This compares the two groups' annual death counts directly, which answers how their levels "
+                "and trends compare year by year. The plotted counts show motorist deaths were higher in all "
+                "13 years. It does not adjust for travel exposure or show fatality rates."
+            ),
+        },
+        {
+            "id": 2,
+            "metric": "Motorist deaths minus cyclist deaths per year",
+            "denominator": "None; absolute difference in annual death counts",
+            "grouping": "Year",
+            "chart_type": "Bar chart of annual differences",
+            "reason": "The annual difference makes the size of the gap between the groups easy to compare over time.",
+            "probability": 0.25,
+            "answer": (
+                f"The motorist–cyclist gap was {int(min_gap['motorist_minus_cyclist_deaths'])} deaths at its smallest "
+                f"({int(min_gap['year'])}) and {int(max_gap['motorist_minus_cyclist_deaths'])} at its largest "
+                f"({int(max_gap['year'])}); it was positive every year."
+            ),
+            "interpretation": (
+                "This frames the comparison as the annual excess of motorist over cyclist deaths, showing how "
+                "the gap changes by year. It is defensible because the question asks how the two counts compare, "
+                "and subtraction directly measures that difference. It does not show either group's underlying "
+                "count separately or compare risk per trip or person."
+            ),
+        },
+    ]
+}
+(OUT / "options.json").write_text(json.dumps(options, indent=2) + "\n")
*** End Patch
